completeness.why: All five provider functions keep only their bank lookup and pass their own data to linkBankSyncAccount, which does the upgrade/insert with payee, the initial sync, handleSyncResponse and the sync event; the preserved differences (mask/official name, Pluggy file id, Akahu's table list) are explicit arguments, and EnableBanking's unreachable id check is dropped.

interface.why: The parameters match the real variation (newAccountFields for mask/official name, optional fileId, syncedTables), with no speculative options; the syncSource union is hard-coded instead of using the existing account_sync_source type, and each wrapper re-lists the four base params instead of passing them through.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies are removed and replaced by calls to linkBankSyncAccount; only the provider-specific bank lookups remain, as the request intends.
